description.value: Big Way Hot Pot Olympic Village is part of a rapidly expanding BC-based self-serve hot pot chain offering over 100 fresh ingredients and more than 18 broths and dry mixes, including signature Mala and slow-simmered Collagen Bone Broth options. Located in the Olympic Village neighbourhood near Vancouver's seawall cycling routes, it offers a customizable, hearty sit-down meal format where each diner cooks ingredients in their own individual pot. The chain has grown to include locations across Metro Vancouver, Ontario, and the United States.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Big Way Hot Pot is an active, multi-location self-serve hot pot chain with an Olympic Village (Vancouver) branch listed under its BC locations, consistent with the OSM branch tag. Vegan options are explicitly noted for the Tomato Broth on the menu page. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content; additionally, the website contains obvious placeholder/template artifacts (lorem ipsum text, contact@sushi.com addresses, fake (414) phone numbers) that undermine confidence in any contact details it does show.
concerns: Website contains prominent placeholder/template content throughout: lorem ipsum body text, fake 'contact@sushi.com' email addresses, and placeholder US phone numbers like '(414) 345-3245' appearing in the location cards — indicates an incomplete or partially customized site build.

Contact page corporate address (2633 Viking Wy #208, Richmond, BC V6V 3B7) is the head office, not the Olympic Village restaurant; OSM street address (115 East 2nd Avenue) is not confirmed anywhere on the website.
OSM phone number (+1-604-566-3888) cannot be confirmed from website content; no location-specific phone is shown for the Olympic Village branch.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is clearly active and the Olympic Village location is well-placed for cycling tourism near the seawall, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify cyclist-friendly amenities before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Olympic Village location is listed in the website's BC > Vancouver location menu alongside Kerrisdale, Robson, UBC, and West End branches, confirming the branch is a real operating unit. A careers page also actively lists 'Olympic Village (BC)' as a hiring location, supporting that the branch is open.
